An exceptional opportunity has arisen for a Vocationally Registered General Practitioner to join a premier, doctor-owned medical centre in the heart of Caringbah. Operating as a high-performing private billing practice, the facility has cultivated a reputation for delivering premium healthcare to the local community. The practice environment is defined by a commitment to high-quality, preventive medicine and a family-friendly culture that prioritizes the professional and personal well-being of its clinicians. 

 The medical centre boasts a sophisticated clinical environment featuring ten modern consultation rooms and a spacious, fully equipped three-bed treatment room. The facility is fully computerized, utilizing Best Practice software and integrated digital systems, such as online bookings and smart check-in triaging, to ensure clinical time is optimized. Practitioners are supported by a comprehensive on-site ecosystem that includes pathology, a compounding pharmacy, and a multidisciplinary team of neurosurgeons, a geriatrician, and various allied health professionals including psychologists, physiotherapists, and dietitians. 

 Clinical staff benefit from a robust support structure designed to streamline daily workflows. The team is comprised of nine experienced GPs, a dedicated practice manager, and a full administrative suite. A strong emphasis is placed on chronic disease management through a nurse-supported CDM model, with three practice nurses available to assist with clinical procedures and patient care. This collaborative atmosphere allows for significant clinical autonomy, enabling the incoming GP to practice medicine in a way that aligns with their professional values while enjoying 15 to 20-minute appointment slots. 

 The practice offers significant flexibility, with both full-time and part-time positions available to suit individual lifestyle needs. In addition to a competitive remuneration of 70% of billings and high earning potential driven by strong patient demand, the GP will find ample opportunities to pursue special interests or take on supervisory roles within the practice. Continuing Professional Development (CPD) is highly encouraged and supported within this intellectually stimulating environment. 

 Situated at a vibrant intersection adjacent to Sutherland Hospital, the location offers unparalleled lifestyle benefits. With secure on-site parking and operating hours limited to weekdays between 7 am and 6 pm, the role ensures an excellent work-life balance. This position is ideal for a dedicated GP holding specialist registration with AHPRA (FRACGP/ACRRM) who seeks to build a loyal patient base within a thriving, professional community in the Sutherland Shire.
